questions.text: Read this passage: 'The barn owl hunts silently at night. Its feathers are specially shaped so that air passes over them without making noise. This allows the owl to surprise its prey.' What is the MAIN IDEA of this passage?
options: Barn owls hunt at night because they cannot see during the day
The barn owl's feathers help it hunt silently
questions.answer: The barn owl's feathers help it hunt silently

questions.text: Read: 'The barn owl hunts silently at night. Its feathers are specially shaped so that air passes over them without making noise.' Which detail BEST supports the main idea?
options: Its feathers let air pass without making noise
questions.answer: Its feathers let air pass without making noise

questions.text: Read: 'After three weeks of drought, dark clouds finally gathered over the parched land. Farmer Reyes looked up and let out a long breath he hadn't realized he'd been holding.' What can you INFER about how Farmer Reyes feels?
options: Relieved and hopeful that rain is coming
Worried the rain will damage his crops
questions.answer: Relieved and hopeful that rain is coming

questions.text: Read: 'The old farmhouse groaned like a tired old man in the wind.' This sentence uses a ___
questions.answer: simile

questions.text: Read: 'The stars were diamonds scattered across a velvet sky.' This sentence uses a ___
questions.answer: metaphor

questions.text: What does the prefix RE- mean in the word 'replant'?
questions.answer: again

questions.text: What does the suffix -FUL mean in the word 'careful'?
questions.answer: full of

questions.text: Read this: 'Texas produces more beef cattle than any other state in the United States. Ranchers in Texas raise millions of cattle each year.' What is the AUTHOR'S PURPOSE?
options: To entertain readers with a story about cowboys
To persuade readers to eat beef
To inform readers about Texas cattle ranching
questions.answer: To inform readers about Texas cattle ranching

questions.text: Read: 'Tomás stared at the wilted plants. He had forgotten to water them for five days. He grabbed the watering can quickly.' What caused Tomás to grab the watering can?
options: His plants were wilted because he forgot to water them
questions.answer: His plants were wilted because he forgot to water them

questions.text: A DYNAMIC character in a story is one who ___
options: changes and grows during the story
questions.answer: changes and grows during the story

questions.text: Read: 'Every morning before sunrise, Grandma Rosa walked the fields, touching each plant and whispering to it like an old friend. She said the plants grew better when they felt loved.' What does this passage tell you about Grandma Rosa's CHARACTER?
options: She is caring and devoted to her farm
She is angry at the plants
questions.answer: She is caring and devoted to her farm

questions.text: The THEME of a story is ___
options: the central message or lesson the author wants readers to understand
what happens at the beginning of the story
questions.answer: the central message or lesson the author wants readers to understand

questions.text: A story about a girl who learns to be honest after lying ends with her friends forgiving her. What is the most likely THEME?
options: Honesty is more important than fitting in
Friends always forgive you no matter what
Girls are more honest than boys
questions.answer: Honesty is more important than fitting in

questions.text: In a COMPARE AND CONTRAST text, the author ___
options: explains a problem and its solution
shows how two or more things are alike and different
gives directions on how to do something
questions.answer: shows how two or more things are alike and different

questions.text: Which text feature would help you quickly find the page where information about soil types begins in a nonfiction book?
options: Both table of contents and index
questions.answer: Both table of contents and index

questions.text: Read: 'Although the soil looked dry and cracked on the surface, the roots of the mesquite tree stretched twenty feet down to find water.' The word ALTHOUGH signals ___
questions.answer: a contrast between two ideas

questions.text: Read: 'The scientist examined the specimen under the microscope.' Using context clues, what does SPECIMEN most likely mean?
options: a sample of something being studied
questions.answer: a sample of something being studied

questions.text: Which sentence states a FACT that can be proven?
options: Texas is the best state to live in.
Bluebonnets are the most beautiful wildflowers.
questions.answer: Texas became a state in 1845.

questions.text: Which sentence states an OPINION?
options: Farming is the most important job in America.
The Rio Grande forms part of the Texas border.
questions.answer: Farming is the most important job in America.

questions.text: In a poem, RHYME SCHEME describes ___
options: the pattern of rhyming sounds at the end of lines
the speed at which you read the poem
questions.answer: the pattern of rhyming sounds at the end of lines

questions.text: Read: 'First, seeds are planted in spring. Then, the plants grow through summer. Next, crops are harvested in fall. Finally, fields rest in winter.' What text structure is this?
questions.answer: Sequential/chronological order

questions.text: Read: 'The crops withered because there was no rain for two months.' What is the EFFECT in this sentence?
questions.answer: The crops withered

questions.text: What does the word ABUNDANT mean in this sentence: 'After the spring rains, wildflowers were abundant across the Texas hillside'?
questions.answer: present in large amounts

questions.text: A BIOGRAPHY is a book written ___
options: by someone about their own life
by one person about another real person's life
questions.answer: by one person about another real person's life

questions.text: An AUTOBIOGRAPHY is different from a biography because it is ___
options: written by the same person the book is about
questions.answer: written by the same person the book is about
